canonical_project: La Hague / Cotentin AI data center candidate site
owner: Région Normandie / prospective AI datacenter investors
notes: DCmag and Le Journal des Entreprises reported Normandy identified La Hague, along with Colombelles near Caen, as potential sites for AI datacenters from the national AI-site effort; actu.fr assesses the Cotentin's suitability (Flamanville) for one of the giant AI data centers France wants to create; no final developer or capacity disclosed.
